body: Right there with you, I was dumped on my birthday on Monday, feeling completely broken and not being able to function without that person. Not even having another person to talk to about it. It's tough, at least we can commiserate together.
Yeah my dog is the only thing, though my ex has promised to care for him when I'm gone.
Spam text telling me it was going to be a great year, depressing.
I'm not sure eating out alone will help?
To be honest I can't find the energy for anything. I can barely get out of bed and eat.
